branding._comment: Reference-only. These paths are duplicated as static <link>/<meta>/JSON-LD tags in every page's <head>; see assets/branding/README.md before changing any of them. All five are real, current production assets as of the Version 3.0 launch-stabilization pass — favicon.svg/favicon-32.png/apple-touch-icon.png were regenerated directly from the real logo mark (assets/branding/logo/logo-mark.png), replacing an obsolete coded three-bar icon that predated the current logo.

seo._comment: Reference-only, same reason as branding above.

analytics._comment: Version 3.3 Milestone M5C (Activation, Analytics and Customer Reconciliation). webAnalyticsToken is the real Cloudflare Web Analytics site-tag token, generated once, manually, from the Cloudflare dashboard (Analytics & Logs > Web Analytics > Add a site) — there is no API to create one, and this project's own principle (docs/v2-analytics-spec.md) is to never fake a data source. Left null until that one-time manual step happens; js/main.js's loadCloudflareWebAnalytics() is a genuine no-op until then, never a fabricated placeholder token. See docs/v3.3-m5c-analytics-architecture.md's Known Limitations.

meta._comment: Version 5.0 (Customer Acquisition Phase 1). pixelId is the real Meta Events Manager Dataset/Pixel ID — non-secret (publicly visible in every page's own network requests once the pixel loads), same reasoning as webAnalyticsToken above. js/main.js's loadMetaPixel() dynamically loads js/components/meta-pixel.js only when this is set — a genuine no-op otherwise, never a fabricated placeholder ID.
